verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              कांस्तत्र सञ्जयापश्यः प्रीत्यर्थेन समागतान्। ये योत्स्यन्ते पाण्डवार्थे पुत्रस्य मम वाहिनीम् ॥१॥
verses.english: Dhritarashtra said Whom have you, O Sanjaya, seen there coming out of love and who will fight with the army of my sons on behalf of the sons of Pandu?

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              मुख्यमन्धकवृष्णीनामपश्यं कृष्णमागतम्। चेकितानं च तत्रैव युयुधानं च सात्यकिम् ॥२॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said The chief of the Andhakas and Vrishnis, Krishna have I seen come there; as also Chekitana, Yuyudhana and Satyaki.

verses.sanskrit: पृथगक्षौहिणीभ्यां तु पाण्डवानभिसंश्रितौ। महारथौ समाख्यातावुभौ पुरुषमानिनौ ॥३॥
verses.english: The two famous and great car-warriors, proud among men, each with a separate Akshauhini of soldiers, have gone to the side of the Pandavas.

verses.sanskrit: अक्षौहिण्याऽथ पाञ्चाल्यो दशभिस्तनयैर्वृतः। सत्यजित्प्रमुखैर्वीरैर्धृष्टद्युम्नपुरोगमैः ॥४॥
verses.english: And the king of the Panchalas Drupada, surrounded by his ten heroic sons, headed by Dhrishtadyumna, with an Akshauhini.

verses.sanskrit: द्रुपदो वर्धयन् मानं शिखण्डिपरिपालितः। उपायात्सर्वसैन्यानां प्रतिच्छाद्य तदा वपुः ॥५॥
verses.english: And protected by Shikhandin has joined them after well protecting the limbs of his soldiers, enhancing the honour of the Pandavas.

verses.sanskrit: विराटः सह पुत्राभ्यां शङ्खेनैवोत्तरेण च। सूर्यदत्तादिभिर्वीरैर्मदिराक्षपुरोगमैः ॥६॥
verses.english: Virata, too, with his two sons Shankha and Uttara and with the heroes Suryadatta and others headed by Madiraksha and with his brother and sons, surrounded by an Akshauhini of troops, has joined the son of Pritha.

verses.sanskrit: सहितः पृथिवीपालो भ्रातृभिस्तनयैस्तथा। अक्षौहिण्यैव सैन्यानां वृतः पार्थं समाश्रितः ॥७॥
जारासन्धिर्मागधश्च धृष्टकेतुश्च चेदिराट्। पृथक् पृथगनुप्राप्तौ पृथगक्षौहिणीवृत्तौ ॥८॥
verses.english: The king of Magadha, the of Jarasandha, too and Dhrishtaketu, the king of the Chedis-these two have come separately each surrounded by an Akshauhini.

verses.sanskrit: केकया भ्रातरः पञ्च सर्वे लोहितकध्वजाः। अक्षौहिणीपरिवृताः पाण्डवानभिसंश्रिताः ॥९॥
verses.english: The five brothers of Kaikeya, all having red flags, surrounded by an Akshauhini, have joined the sons of Pandu.

verses.sanskrit: एतानेतावतस्तत्र तानपश्यं समागतान्। ये पाण्डवार्थे योत्स्यन्ति धार्तराष्ट्रस्य वाहिनीम् ॥१०॥
verses.english: These parties and of their respective numbers have I seen come there, who will fight with the army of Dhritarashtra, on behalf of the sons of Pandu. son

verses.sanskrit: यो वेद मानुषं व्यूहं दैवं गान्धर्वमासुरम्। स तत्र सेनाप्रमुखे धृष्टद्युन्नो महारथः ॥११॥
verses.english: He, who is acquainted with the human system of fight, is celestial and is followed by the Gandharvas and by the Asuras that great car-warrior, Dhrishtadyumna, is at the head of that army.

verses.sanskrit: भीष्मः शांतनवो राजन्‌ भागः क्लुप्तः शिखण्डिनः। तं विराटोऽनुसंयाता सार्धं मत्स्यैः प्रहारिभिः ॥१२॥
verses.english: Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, O king, has been reserved as the share of Shikhandin. Virata will help him (the latter) along with the soldiers from Matsya.

verses.sanskrit: ज्येष्ठस्य पाण्डुपुत्रस्य भागो मद्राधिपो बली। तौ तु तत्राब्रुवन् केचिद्विषमौ नो मताविति ॥१३॥
verses.english: The ruler of the Madras, endued with strength, has been reserved as the share of the eldest son of Pandu, through somebody in their party said that he was of opinion that the two did match very well.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनः सहसुतः सार्धं भ्रातृशतेन च। प्राच्याश्च दाक्षिणात्याश्च भीमसेनस्य भागतः ॥१४॥
verses.english: Duryodhana with his son and his hundred brothers and the soldiers coming from the castern and southern countries have fallen to the share of Bhimasena.

verses.sanskrit: अर्जुनस्य तु भागेन कर्णो वैकर्तनो मतः। अश्वत्थामा विकर्णश्च सैन्धवश्च जयद्रथः ॥१५॥
verses.english: Arjuna has for his share Karna the son of Vikartana, Ashvathaman, Vikarna and the king of Sindhu Jayadratha.

verses.sanskrit: अशक्याश्चैव ये केचित् पृथिव्यां शूरमानिनः। सर्वांस्तानर्जुनः पार्थः कल्पयामास भागतः ॥१६॥
verses.english: Whoever there is in this world who boasts that he is invincible. Arjuna, the son Pritha, has accepted all of them also as his share.

verses.sanskrit: महेष्वासा राजपुत्रा भ्रातरः पञ्च केकयाः। केकयानेव भागेन कृत्वा योत्स्यन्ति संयुगे ॥१७॥
verses.english: The great bowmen, the five Kaikeya princes, brothers to one another, taking the Kaikeya warriors (on the Kurus side) for his share, will fight in the battle. same sons

verses.sanskrit: तेषामेव कृतो भागो मालवाः शाल्वकास्तथा। त्रिगर्तानां चैव मुख्यौ यौ तौ संशप्तकाविति ॥१८॥
verses.english: In their share have also fallen the Malavas, the Shalvakas and the two foremost of the Trigartas, who have resolved to win or to die.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनसुताः सर्वे तथा दुःशासनस्य च। सौभद्रेण कृतो भागो राजा चैव बृहद्वलः ॥१९॥
verses.english: In the way all the sons of Duryodhana and Dushasana have been accepted by the son of Subhadra as his share, as also the king Brihadbala.

verses.sanskrit: द्रौपदेया महेष्वासाः सुवर्णविकृतध्वजाः। धृष्टद्युम्नमुखा द्रोणमभियास्यन्ति भारत ॥२०॥
verses.english: The mighty bowmen, the of Draupadi, having their flag ornamented with gold, with Dhrishtadyumna at their head, will fight with Drona, O Bharata.

verses.sanskrit: चेकितानः सोमदत्तं द्वैरथे योद्धुमिच्छति। भोजं तु कृतवर्माणं युयुधानो युयुत्सति ॥२१॥
verses.english: Chekitana desires to fight with Somadatta in single combat, each seated on his own car; and Yuyudhana is desirous of fighting against Kritavarma of the Bhoja tribe.

verses.sanskrit: सहदेवस्तु माद्रेयः शूरः सङ्क्रन्द‌नो युधि। स्वमंशं कल्पयामास श्यालं ते सुबलात्मजम् ॥२२॥
verses.english: The son of Madri, the hero Sahadeva, who makes loud roars in battle, has accepted as his own share your brother the son of Subala.

verses.sanskrit: उलूकं चैव कैतव्यं ये च सारस्वता गणाः। नकुलः कल्पयामास भागं माद्रवतीसुतः ॥२३॥
verses.english: Uluka, the deceitful one and hordes of Sarasvata tribes have been accepted by Nakula, the son of Madravati; as his own share.

verses.sanskrit: ये चान्ये पार्थिवा राजन् प्रत्युद्यास्यन्ति सङ्गरे। समाह्वानेन तांश्चापि पाण्डुपुत्रा अकल्पयन् ॥२४॥
verses.english: The other rulers, too, Oking, who will fight in the battle, have been assigned to the share of some one on their side by the sons of Pandu.

verses.sanskrit: एवमेषामनीकानि प्रविभक्तानि भागशः। यत्ते कार्यं सपुत्रस्य क्रियतां तदकालिकम् ॥२५॥
verses.english: In this way has this army been divided into batches. Do whatever is to be done by you, along with your son, speedily.

verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              न सन्ति सर्वे पुत्रा मे मूढा दुर्द्यूतदेविनः। येषां युद्धं बलवता भमिन रणमूर्धनि ॥२६॥
verses.english: Dhritarashtra said All my foolish sons, those addicted to the wicked dice who have taken it in their hand to fight with the powerful Bhima, have ceased to exist already.

verses.sanskrit: राजानः पार्थिवाः सर्वे प्रोक्षिताः कालधर्मणा। गाण्डीवाग्निं प्रवेक्ष्यन्ति पतङ्गा इव पावकम् ॥२७॥
verses.english: The kings and the rulers, too, all consecrated by the king of death himself shall enter the Gandiva bow as moths fall on fire.

verses.sanskrit: विद्रुतां वाहिनीं मन्ये कृतवैरैर्महात्मभिः। तां रणे केऽनुयास्यन्ति प्रभग्नां पाण्डवैर्युधि ॥२८॥
verses.english: I see in my mind my army already routed by these large minded ones, whom I converted into enemies, who will follow them to battle, who have been routed by the Pandavas in fight.
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रोक्षिताः पशुवत् वधार्थं संस्कृताः कालधर्मणा यजमानेन वा ॥२७॥

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे ह्यतिरथाः शूराः कीर्तिमन्तः प्रतापिनः। सूर्यपावकयोस्तुल्यास्तेजसा समितिञ्जयाः ॥२९॥
verses.english: All of them are extremely good carwarriors, heroes, famous and powerful having might like that of the sun or fire and victorious in battle.

verses.sanskrit: येषां युधिष्ठिरो नेता गोप्ता च मधुसूदनः। योधौ च पाण्डवौ वीरौ सव्यसाचिवृकोदरौ ॥३०॥
verses.english: son Those whose leader is Yudhishthira and whose protector is the slayer of Madhu and whose warriors are the heroic sons of Pandu, Savyasachin and Vrikodara and Nakula, Sahadeva, Dhrishtadyumna, the of Prishata, Satyki, Drupada, with his brother and the king of the Panchalas, endued with excellent prowess and the invincible Yudhamanyu and Shikhandin and Kshatradeva and Uttra and the son Virata and the Kashis, the Chedis, the Matsyas and all the Srinjayas, the son of Virata, Babhru, the Panchalas and the Prabhadrakas. From these even Indra himself cannot wrest this Earth, if they are not so willing-the heroes, who are cool and composed in battle and who are capable even of breaking the mountains, my wicked son desires to fight, O Sanjaya-these endued with all the virtues and endued with superhuman strength, disregard me me who am loudly protesting.

verses.sanskrit: नकुलः सहदेवश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः। सात्यकिर्द्रुपद‌श्चैव धृष्टकेतुश्च सानुजः ॥३१॥
उत्तमौजाश्च पाञ्चाल्यो युधामन्युश्च दुर्जयः। शिखण्डी क्षत्रदेवश्च तथा वैराटिरुत्तरः ॥३२॥
काशयश्चेदयश्चैव मत्स्याः सर्वे च सृञ्जयाः। विराटपुत्रो बभ्रुश्च पाञ्चालाश्च प्रभद्रकाः ॥३३॥
येषामिन्द्रोऽप्यकामानां न हरेत् पृथिवीमिमाम्। वीराणां रणधीराणां ये भिन्द्युः पर्वतानपि ॥३४॥
तान् सर्वगुणसम्पन्नानमनुष्यप्रतापिनः। क्रोशतो मम दुष्पुत्रो योद्धुमिच्छति सञ्जय ॥३५॥

दुर्योधन उवाच।
              उभौ स्व एकजातीयौ तथोभौ भूमिगोचरौ। अथ कस्मात् पाण्डवानामेकतो मन्यसे जयम् ॥३६॥
verses.english: Duryodhana said Both the parties are of the same race and both roam about on the earth; why then do you regard victory as coming solely to the Pandavas.

verses.sanskrit: पितामहं च द्रोणं च कृपं कर्णं च दुर्जयम्। जयद्रथं सोमदत्तमश्वत्थामानमेव च ॥३७॥
verses.english: Our grandfather Bhishma, Drona, Kripa and Karna hard to be vanquished, Jayadratha, Somadatta and Ashvathama, Indra even, united with the gods, is incapable of defeating these great bowmen endued with great energy in battle. How can the Pandavas do it, O sire.

verses.sanskrit: सुतेजसो महेष्वासानिन्द्रोऽपि सहितोऽमरैः। अशक्तः समरे जेतुं किं पुनस्तात पाण्डवाः ॥३८॥
सर्वे च पृथिवीपाला मदर्थे तात पाण्डवान्। आर्याः शस्त्रभृतः शूराः समर्थाः प्रतिबाधितुम् ॥३९॥
verses.english: All the rulers of the earth, too, leading honourable lives, the heroes capable of wielding weapons can for my sake, O sire, oppose the Pandavas.

verses.sanskrit: न मामकान् पाण्डवास्ते समर्थाः प्रतिवीक्षितुम्। पराक्रान्तो ह्यहं पाण्डून् सपुत्रान् योद्धुमोहवे ॥४०॥
verses.english: These Pandavas are not even able to gaze on my soldiers. I am sufficiently powerful to challenge the Pandus with their sons to fight.

verses.sanskrit: मत्प्रियं पार्थिवाः सर्वे ये चिकीर्षन्ति भारत। ते तानावारयिष्यन्ति ऐणेयानिव तन्तुना ॥४१॥
verses.english: Those rulers of the earth, who wish me well, O Bharata, will get hold of them, as deer are caught by means of a trap.

verses.sanskrit: महता रथवंशेन शरजालैश्च मामकैः। अभिद्रुता भविष्यन्ति पाञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सह ॥४२॥
verses.english: By means of our large number of cars and our net of arrows, the Panchalas along with the Pandavas will be vanquished.

verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              उन्मत्त इव मे पुत्रो विलपत्येष सञ्जय। न हि शक्तो रणे जेतुं धर्मराजं युधिष्ठिरम् ॥४३॥
verses.english: Dhritarashtra said My son raves like a maniac, O Sanjaya; he is not capable of defeating in battle Yudhishthira the king of Dharma.

verses.sanskrit: जानाति हि यथा भीष्मः पाण्डवानां यशस्विनाम्। बलवत्तां सपुत्राणां धर्मज्ञानां महात्मनाम् ॥४४॥
verses.english: Bhishma knows the truth of the sons of Pandu and their sons of great fame and prowess, conversant with the code of morality and having large minds.

verses.sanskrit: यतो नारोचयदयं विग्रहं तैर्महात्मभिः। किं तु सञ्जय मे ब्रूहि पुनस्तेषां विचेष्टितम् ॥४५॥
verses.english: Since he does not desire fight with those ones of great soul; but, O Sanjaya, tell me again of their doings.

verses.sanskrit: कस्तांस्तरस्विनो भूयः सन्दीपयति पाण्डवान्। अर्चिष्मतो महेष्वासान् हविषा पावकानिव ॥४६॥
verses.english: Who among them are endued with activity and who are inciting the Pandavas. These great bowinen are like those pouring clarified butter on fire.

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              धृष्टद्युम्नः सदैवैतान् सन्दीपयति भारत। युद्ध्यध्वमिति मा भैष्ट युद्धाद्भरतसत्तमाः ॥४७॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Dhritarashtra is ever inciting them, O Bharata, saying, “Fight and do not fear a fight, you best among the race of Bharata.

verses.sanskrit: ये केचित्पार्थिवास्तत्र धार्तराष्ट्रेण संवृताः। युद्धे समागमिष्यन्ति तुमले शस्त्रसङ्कुले ॥४८॥
verses.english: The few rulers of the earth, who are surrounded by the sons of Dhritarashtra, will engage in fierce fight with marks of numberless weapons on their bodies.

verses.sanskrit: तान् सर्वानाहवे क्रुद्धान् सानुबन्धान् समागतान्। अहमेकः समादास्ये तिमिर्मत्स्यानिवोदकात् ॥४९॥
verses.english: All these wrathful kings who have assembled on the other side, with their friends and followers, I alone will capture like a big fish, seizing small ones from the water.

verses.sanskrit: भीष्मं द्रोणं कृपं कर्णं द्रौणिं शल्यं सुयोधनम्। एतांश्चापि निरोत्स्यामि वेलेव मकरालयम् ॥५०॥
verses.english: Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, Karna, the son of Drona, Shalya and Suyodhana-these I will opposed like the shore, resisting the flow of the swelling waters.

verses.sanskrit: तथा ब्रुवन्तं धर्मात्मा प्राह राजा युधिष्ठिरः। तव धैर्यं च वीर्यं च पाञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सह ॥५१॥
verses.english: King Yudhishthira of a virtuous soul said to him who was thus speaking-'The Panchalas along with the Pandavas all depend on your wisdom and prowess.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे समधिरूढाः स्म साङ्ग्रामान्नः समुद्धर। जानामि त्वां महाबाहो क्षेत्रधर्मे व्यवस्थितम् ॥५२॥
verses.english: Rescue us from this fight; I am aware that you, O you with long arms, are established on the virtue of a Kshatriya.

verses.sanskrit: समर्थमेकं पर्याप्तं कौरवाणां विनिग्रहे। पुरस्तादुपयातानां कौरवाणां युयुत्सताम् ॥५३॥
verses.english: Alone you are quite capable of effecting the overthrow of the Kauravas. To meet the Kauravas, desirous of war and standing in front of us.

verses.sanskrit: पौरुषं दर्शयन् शूरो यस्तिष्ठेदग्रतः पुमान्। क्रीणीयात्तं सहस्त्रेण इति नीतिमतां मतम् ॥५५॥
verses.english: The hero, who after showing forth his strength himself helps such men (those flying, referred to in the last Sloka), is worth purchasing for a thousand. Such is the opinion of those who are conversant with the code of morality.

verses.sanskrit: स त्वं शूरश्च वीरश्च विक्रान्तश्च नरर्षभ। भयार्तानां परित्राता संयुगेषु न संशयः ॥५६॥
verses.english: O you bull among men, you are just such a hero, brave and powerful. There is no doubt that in battle you are the rescuer of those struck with fear.

verses.sanskrit: भवता यद्विधातव्यं तन्नः श्रेयः परन्तप। सङ्ग्रामादपयातानां भग्नानां शरणैषिणाम् ॥५७॥
verses.english: What ever will be decided on by you will conduce to our good, O subduer of foes, why those fly from the field of battle out of the original army and are at our mercy.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ब्रुवति कौन्तेये धर्मात्मनि युधिष्ठिरे। धृष्टद्युम्न उवाचेदं मां वचो गतसाध्वसम्। सर्वान् जनपदान् सूत योधा दुर्योधनस्य ये ॥५७॥
verses.english: What ever will be decided on by you will conduce to our good, O subduer of foes, why those fly from the field of battle out of the original army and are at our mercy.

verses.sanskrit: सबाह्लिकान् कुरून् ब्रूयाः प्रातिपेयान् शरद्वतः। सूतपुत्रं तथा द्रोणं सहपुत्रं जयद्रथम् ॥५८॥
verses.english: The son of Kunti, Yudhishthira, of virtuous soul having said this Dhrishtadyumna without the least fear said these words to me-O Suta, all the men that have come to fight for Duryodhana, tell them and the Kurus who have descended from the Pratipas with the Bahlika's, son of Sharadvata and Drona with his son, as also Jayadratha with his son and Dushasana and Vikarna and also the king Duryodhana and Bhima-go to them and tell them go just now, without delay.

verses.sanskrit: दुःशासनं विकर्णं च तथा दुर्योधनं नृपम्। भीष्मं च ब्रूहि गत्वा त्वमाशु गच्छ च मा चिरम् ॥५९॥
युधिष्ठिरः साधु नैवाभ्युपेयो मा वोऽवधीदर्जुनो देवगुप्तः। राज्यं दद्ध्वं धर्मराजस्य तूर्णं याचध्वं वै पाण्डवं लोकवीरम् ॥६०॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira should be approached by an honourable man, let not Arjuna, protected by the gods, kill you and the king of virtue the son of Pandu-that hero among men should be forthwith asked to accept the kingdom surrender to him.

verses.sanskrit: नैतादृशो हि योधोऽस्ति पृथिव्यामिह कश्चन। यथाविधः सव्यसाची पाण्डवः सत्यविक्रमः ॥६१॥
verses.english: There is no warrior in this world as the son of Pandu, Savyasachin of true strength.

verses.sanskrit: देवैर्हि संभृतो दिव्यो रथो गाण्डीवधन्वनः। न स जेयो मनुष्येण मा स्म कृद्ध्वं मनो युधि ॥६२॥
verses.english: By the gobs themselves in the heavenly car of the wielder of the Gandiva bow protected; he cannot be defeated by men; do not think in mind even of a fight with him.
